title: Program Proposal and Dataset Summarization
summary: This module provides tools for generating descriptions of datasets and programs, and for proposing new instructions for language models based on these descriptions and historical performance.

nodes.label: Summarize Observations
nodes.title: Observation Summarizer
nodes.description: Condenses a series of dataset observations into a brief, highlighted summary, focusing on the most important details.

nodes.label: Describe Dataset
nodes.title: Dataset Descriptor
nodes.description: Analyzes sample data points to identify trends and make educated guesses about the dataset's task, generating observations.

nodes.label: Describe Dataset with Prior Observations
nodes.title: Dataset Descriptor with Prior Observations
nodes.description: Extends dataset description by incorporating existing observations and adding new ones, or indicating completeness.

nodes.label: Describe Program
nodes.title: Describe Program
nodes.description: Analyzes program pseudocode and examples to describe the task it solves and its operational mechanism.

nodes.label: Describe Module
nodes.title: Describe Module
nodes.description: Focuses on a specific module within a program, describing its role and purpose in the overall pipeline.

nodes.label: Generate Module Instruction
nodes.title: Generate Single Module Instruction
nodes.description: Generates new instructions for a language model based on dataset descriptions, program details, module descriptions, and historical instruction performance.

nodes.label: Create Instruction History String
nodes.title: Create Instruction Set History String
nodes.description: Processes trial logs to create a formatted string of top-performing program instruction sets and their scores, used for historical context.

groups.label: Dataset Analysis
groups.title: Dataset Analysis
groups.description: Components responsible for analyzing and summarizing dataset characteristics and observations.

groups.label: Program Analysis
groups.title: Program Analysis
groups.description: Components for understanding and describing the functionality of programs and their individual modules.

groups.label: Instruction Generation
groups.title: Instruction Generation
groups.description: Components focused on generating and refining instructions for language models based on various inputs.
